name: The pumping works' grounds
address: East of Pine Street between Chicago Avenue and Pearson Street, North Side

status.text: Its railing stood through the fire
status.today: The grounds of the Chicago Avenue Pumping Station
status.note: The railing still stands in a photograph of the works taken after the fire.

built.note: Laid out with the water works, begun in 1867.

summary: The open ground in front of the pumping works. The engine house stood back from the street behind an iron railing. No houses stood between it and Chicago Avenue.

key.label: Behind it
key.value: The pumping works, whose roof burned

notable.text: An 1866-67 print shows the works standing back across open ground, with no house in front.
How far the grounds reached toward the lake is a guess.
notable.note: No survey of the works' lot was found.

story.text: The works' roof catches fire at about 3:20 in the morning. The railing in front still stands.
story.note: Andreas gives the hour. A photograph taken after the fire shows the railing standing.
